blocks.text: Acreage and rural land in Fraser Valley

items.t: ALR vs non-ALR is the first split in every valley acreage trade: The structural profile that is sourced: acreage housing in the ALR is freehold in practice and single-residence-led — one principal residence (≤500 m²) plus at most one additional residence (90 m² / 186 m² by parcel size), a secondary suite only inside the principal residence, and no stratification without ALC permission — so the multi-unit strata profile of urban pages does not exist on ALR parcels. A valley-wide ALR share of the acreage stock: Not verified — no official or permitted source publishes one.

Serviced vs unserviced is the second split: Built urban-fringe parcels sit on municipal water and sewer under their city's or township's servicing bylaw; rural and FVRD parcels trade on well and septic, with water licences and irrigation rights as separate parcel facts.

items.t: What the page is: a regional topic page titled "Fraser Valley Acreages for Sale | Rural Homes & Estates," whose editorial copy spans the Fraser Valley "from Langley to Chilliwack and beyond" and links out to Langley acreages, a farmland-buying guide, Fraser Valley farms, and South Surrey farms and acreage pages. It is not an area page and has no boundary of its own.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect acreage buyers in Fraser Valley

items.t: Abbotsford frame (Abbotsford parcels only, for contrast): OCP Abbotsforward 2050 CURRENT; SSMUH bylaw number not confirmed (never assert "3560-2024"); secondary suite capped under 50%; coach/garden suite 15% of lot area to a maximum 100 m² (Abbotsford only, never exported); taxes due July 2, 5% July 3, +5% September 16, 2026; Abbotsford HAS a Supreme Court registry. None of this applies to a Township, Surrey, Mission or FVRD parcel.

Mission / FVRD frames (each as its own): City of Mission — OCP 6405-2026 (adopted June 1, 2026); Zoning 5949-2020; SSMUH incorporation Bylaw 6299-2024 (unit counts not confirmed); DSCB 5650-2017 (City source); flat 10% tax penalty after July 2 (Community Charter ss.233–234); no Supreme Court registry (mapping not verified). FVRD rural ground — Taxation (Rural Area) Act s.11: taxes due July 2, 5% on amounts unpaid July 2 + further 5% on amounts unpaid October 31; notice from the Surveyor of Taxes, paid to the Province; FVRD bylaw numbers not verified, never borrowed. A parcel's frame follows its jurisdiction, never its mailing address or its board sub-area.

blocks.text: Good to know about Fraser Valley

items.t: There is no acreage statistic to hide behind: Every community figure a buyer sees beside an acreage listing is a housing figure (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined) that contains the acreage without measuring it. Pricing an acreage parcel by parcel — on its own community's comparables, its ALR status, water, buildings and farm income — is not a preference in this market; it is the only method the permitted sources support.
The stratification sentence is the valley's most-misstated rule: The correct form is "cannot be stratified WITHOUT the ALC's permission" (Bulletin 09 s.6; ALCA s.21(1)) — a permission rule.

Servicing numbers do not transfer between jurisdictions: a buyer comparing a Township parcel (Bylaw 5382) with an FVRD parcel (numbers not verified) and a Chilliwack parcel (candidate 3055, not adopted) is looking at three different positions, not three comparable numbers — for the second and third the honest answer is the process, and Mission's or Chilliwack's numbers should not be applied to FVRD ground.

blocks.text: The Agricultural Land Reserve, farm class and GST on farm land are explained on their own page.

faq.a: Generally one principal residence (maximum 500 m² total floor area), plus, where the property qualifies, one additional residence capped at 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha; more than that, or a larger residence, requires ALC approval, and local bylaws may restrict further.
faq.q: How many homes can I have on an ALR acreage?

faq.a: BC Assessment's minimum gross farm income (farm gate) thresholds are $2,500 for an operation of 0.8 ha to 4 ha, $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha for a larger operation, and $10,000 for an operation under 0.8 ha; new applications are due by the legislated October 31 deadline.
faq.q: What farm income does an acreage need to keep farm classification?

faq.a: Many do. Ask for the well flow test and water quality results, and the septic filing and inspection records, before you remove conditions.
faq.q: Do acreages in Fraser Valley have wells and septic?

faq.a: It depends on the zoning, whether the land is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, servicing and the minimum lot size, and it needs municipal approval. Ask the municipality before you buy with a subdivision in mind.
